title: ExpliCa: Evaluating Explicit Causal Reasoning in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Computing statistical association strength using Pointwise Mutual Information (PMI) and Local Mutual Information (LMI) between pairs of lexemes across sentence pairs to ensure models cannot exploit simple lexical artifacts.
Extracting verb-connective-verb triplets and analyzing their co-occurrence frequency in the enTenTen21 corpus to check if model performance is skewed toward more frequent linguistic constructions.
